entities.title: Unexpected errors in the API and sign-in
entities.summary: An error thrown while answering api/ or auth/ is logged and answered with a JSON 500.
entities.name: console.error
entities.meaning: Something failed while answering an API or sign-in request: a database error, a failed fetch of a picture, or a bug.
entities.access: Whoever can read the Worker's logs in the Cloudflare account (wrangler tail, or the dashboard).
excludes: Errors from the page, index.wasm and static assets, which are not caught here.
Refusals the code answers on purpose (400 to 429).
entities.details: wrangler.jsonc sets no observability block, so how long the lines are kept is Cloudflare's default.

entities.title: Cloudflare Web Analytics
entities.summary: Page views reported by Cloudflare's beacon, which the page's Content-Security-Policy allows.
excludes: Anything inside the game: invitations, moves, chat and players are not reported.
entities.details: Nothing in this folder emits it: the CSP allows static.cloudflareinsights.com and cloudflareinsights.com for a beacon Cloudflare adds.

entities.title: Failed requests in the client
entities.summary: A request the client cannot complete is pushed as a warning to the browser's console.
entities.name: push_warning
entities.meaning: A request to the server failed to complete (no answer, not an HTTP error status).
entities.access: Only the player, in their browser's console.
excludes: Nothing is sent to the server.
